character_description: Young adult male in his early 30s, deep and precise voice, analytical and calculated tone, deliberate pacing, cold rationality with strategic depth, professional businessman quality. Studio-quality recording.
audition_line: 数据不会骗人。根据我目前掌握的信息，这批科技藏品的估值区间已经很明确了。投资讲究的是风险收益比，不是盲目跟风，该出手时绝不犹豫，该放弃时也绝不恋战。
